device.hinge: Division region while partially folded; zero width when flat.

rules.zh: 按尺寸类别设计，不按姿态设计：外屏按 Compact，内屏按 Regular。
rules.en: Design for size classes, not poses: compact on the outer display, regular on the inner.

rules.zh: 能点的东西远离折痕，滚动内容不受限；自定义网格优先用偶数列。
rules.en: Keep interactive elements away from the hinge; scrolling content may cross it. Prefer even column counts.

rules.zh: 栏改竖向：外屏放右侧，内屏横向放侧边；系统组件自动适配，自己画的不会。
rules.en: Bars go vertical: right edge on the outer display, side edge on the inner landscape. System bars adapt; custom ones do not.

rules.zh: 内屏三种用法：分栏、重排成两列、Tab 变侧栏。
rules.en: Three ways to use the inner display: split view, reflow to two columns, tab bar to sidebar.

title.zh: 封面 · 同一份内容，两种屏幕

summary.zh: 三种屏幕形态的尺寸、尺寸类别和栏的位置，加 4 条核心规则。
summary.en: Sizes, size classes and bar placement for the three display states, plus the four core rules.

summary.zh: 同一套组件只换容器方向：展开横排，折叠竖排；折叠时图片压到约 1/3 屏高。
summary.en: Same components, different container axis: side by side when open, stacked when closed, image shrunk to about a third.

summary.zh: 两栏以折痕为界各占一面；折叠后只留列表，每行加 ›；只有详情栏换成竖向栏。
summary.en: Columns meet at the hinge; closed shows the list with disclosure arrows; only the detail column gets the vertical bar.

summary.zh: 内容密集的 App 在内屏把 Tab 升级成带文字的侧栏；外屏 Tab 在右侧竖排、靠下。
summary.en: Dense apps turn the tab bar into a labelled sidebar on the inner display; on the outer display tabs sit low on the right edge.

summary.zh: 内屏 6 列 = 左右各 3 列，折痕落在列缝；不写死列数，写每格最小宽度。
summary.en: Six columns as three per half so the hinge lands in a gutter; set a minimum cell width instead of a fixed count.

summary.zh: 书脊对准折痕；中文一行 30–40 字；切换时按段落定位，不按页码。
summary.en: The spine sits on the hinge; keep line length readable; restore position by paragraph, not page number.

summary.zh: 视频左半、评论右半；折叠后简介和评论合成分段 Tab；播放不中断。
summary.en: Video on one half, comments on the other; closed merges details and comments into a segmented control; playback never restarts.

summary.zh: 左半看图，右半选规格下单；图标操作进竖栏，“立即购买”这类文字按钮留在内容里。
summary.en: Gallery left, options and purchase right; icon actions go to the vertical bar, text buttons stay in content.

summary.zh: 折叠后停在正在聊的对话，不跳回列表；草稿不丢。
summary.en: When closing, stay in the open conversation instead of jumping back to the list; keep the draft.

summary.zh: 月历整块放左面，日程放右面；折叠后收成一周横条，选中日期不丢。
summary.en: Month grid on one half, agenda on the other; closed collapses to a week strip and keeps the selected date.

summary.zh: 地图铺满；同一个面板宽屏浮在左侧，窄屏变三档底部抽屉。
summary.en: Full-bleed map; the same panel floats on the side when wide and becomes a three-detent sheet when compact.

summary.zh: 放得下两栏就别再点进下一层；开关属于编辑控件，留在内容里。
summary.en: Show categories and options side by side when there is room; toggles stay in content, not in the bar.

summary.zh: 4 个指标拆成两组各占一面，图表不横跨折痕；放不下就换行，不压缩字号。
summary.en: Split KPI tiles into pairs per half, keep charts off the hinge, wrap instead of shrinking type.

summary.zh: 画布一面、参数一面；竖栏顺序：关闭 → 完成 → 工具。
summary.en: Canvas on one half, parameters on the other; vertical bar order: close, done, tools.

summary.zh: 左面正在播放，右面接下来；帐篷姿态封面在上、按钮在下。
summary.en: Now playing on one half, up next on the other; in tent pose, artwork up top and controls below.

summary.zh: 从上到下：返回/关闭 → 主操作 → 次要工具 → 溢出菜单 → Tab 栏；只放图标；自己画的底栏不会自动变竖。
summary.en: Top to bottom: back/close, primary action, secondary tools, overflow, tab bar. Icons only. Custom bottom bars do not turn vertical.

summary.zh: 书本姿态弹窗移到一侧；桌面姿态上看下点；3 列网格会被劈开，改 2 列；滚动内容不需要避让。
summary.en: Book pose moves alerts to one side; tabletop puts viewing up top and touch below; switch three columns to two; scrolling content is exempt.

cards.swiftui: GeometryProxy reserved regions (iOS 27.1, confirm against the SDK)

title.zh: 场景篇封面 · 12 个真实场景
体育直播 · 桌面姿态

summary.zh: 立起的一半看比赛，平放的一半看数据和竞猜；视频高度等于上半屏。
summary.en: The upright half plays the game, the flat half shows stats and actions; video height equals the top half.

cards.swiftui: Arrangement split mode (iOS 27.1, confirm against the SDK)

summary.zh: 上半只放当前一步、字号放大；“下一步”放下半做到 60pt 以上；屏幕常亮。
summary.en: Top half shows only the current step in large type; a 60pt+ Next button sits below; keep the screen awake.

title.zh: 航班追踪 · 一眼可读

summary.zh: 支起来当仪表：一个大数字、深色低亮、几乎不需要操作。
summary.en: A propped-up gauge: one big number, dark and dim, almost no interaction.

title.zh: 健身跟练 · 一个 App 四种姿态

summary.zh: 同一节课四种摆法，内容和层级不变；离手越远，按钮越少、字越大。
summary.en: One class in four poses with the same hierarchy; the farther from the hand, the fewer buttons and the larger the type.

title.zh: 双屏同显 · 拍照预览

summary.zh: 内屏给拍的人操作，外屏给被拍的人看预览和倒计时；外屏不放按钮。
summary.en: The photographer controls the inner display; the subject sees the preview and countdown outside, with no buttons there.

cards.swiftui: Scene accessory (iOS 27.1, confirm against the SDK)

summary.zh: 一面看共享内容，一面看参会者；参会者网格用偶数列；挂断放竖栏最下面。
summary.en: Shared content on one half, participants on the other in an even grid; leave sits at the bottom of the bar.

summary.zh: 背景铺满，内容最宽 600pt，按钮最宽 400pt；关闭交给系统导航；居中按钮半折时会压在折痕上。
summary.en: Full-width background, content capped at 600pt, CTA at 400pt; system close button; a centred CTA lands on the hinge when folded.

title.zh: 视频剪辑 · 时间线横跨

summary.zh: 预览一面、参数一面，时间线铺满底部；时间线可滚动，可以横跨折痕。
summary.en: Preview and parameters on separate halves, a full-width timeline below; the scrolling timeline may cross the hinge.

title.zh: DJ 双碟 · 对称布局

summary.zh: 两件对等的东西一面一个；横跨中线的推子半折时拆成两侧各一个。
summary.en: Two equal objects, one per half; a control spanning the centre splits into two when folded.

title.zh: 电商瀑布流 · 捏合调列数

summary.zh: 双指捏合切换 2/4/6 列，只给偶数档，折痕永远落在列缝。
summary.en: Pinch between 2, 4 and 6 columns; even steps only, so the hinge always lands in a gutter.

summary.zh: 折叠刷短片、打开接着看；打开选专辑、合上开始播；状态必须连续。
summary.en: Browse clips closed, keep watching open; pick an album open, close to play; state must carry over.

summary.zh: 你的 App 可能只拿到半块屏，必须按 Compact 也好用；分屏时各自的竖栏靠外侧。
summary.en: Your app may get half the screen and must work as compact; each app keeps its bar on its outer edge.
